markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Models agree on Benign with 0% invasive risk [F1], though 4 of 5 similar cases are Normal [F5].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 99%, Normal 1%, Invasive 0% | Strong Benign call; zero invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (α = 0.1, 90% coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability; 36th OOD percentile (12/12 regions) [F6] | Typical image quality and appearance |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent models match top call |
| Similar cases | 1/5 Benign, 4/5 Normal (89%–91% similarity) | Mostly Normal neighbors; check overlap |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 7, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-1.464); 0/20 AI spot check is unreliable [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 4, 7) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.358) pushes away from invasive (20/20 check) [F3] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.461) slightly raises invasive score (+0.351) [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Mildly elevated (+0.177) in top-risk region; separates from Normal neighbor · Validated
- **HoVer-Net cell measurements** (regions 0, 8, 11) · context · 92nd-percentile TIL proximity [F7], 4th-percentile epithelium [F8]; sparse tumor nuclei · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability more than random (95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 spans 0), relying heavily on unreliable normal lobules (0/20 AI check).

## Could be wrong if
- Tissue is Normal rather than Benign, matching 4 of 5 nearest reference cases (89%–91% similarity).
- Region 11 contains focal atypia or invasion (4% tile risk, 15 neoplastic nuclei, sparse tumor nuclei flag).

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 11**: Inspect 15 segmented neoplastic nuclei, 4% tile risk, and stromal infiltration score (row 2, col 3).
2. **Regions 0, 4, 7, 8**: Verify benign fibrous stroma, fat, and lobular architecture versus Normal breast tissue.
3. **Region 1**: Confirm absence of duct-confined atypia driving the minor positive score shift (row 0, col 1).
